agency.name: Behavioral Health and Developmental Disabilities Division (BHDD), Montana Department of Public Health and Human Services

narrNote: Montana's affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list under its former name, Recovery Residence Alliance of Montana; the organization now operates as Recovery Access Montana (rammontana.org, verified live).
notes: NASADAD's Single State Agency listing names the SSA under DPHHS's Public Health and Safety Division umbrella; the division that administers substance-use services is BHDD, whose official division page is used here. Agency phone (406) 444-3964 is the number DPHHS publishes for Adult Mental Health, prevention, and grant-funded programs, including state-paid substance-use treatment information through the Chemical Dependency Bureau. The DPHHS crisis page also publishes the peer-run Montana Warm Line, 1-877-688-3377. Medicaid SUD URL is BHDD's 'Substance Use Disorder Services and Resources' page, which covers the Medicaid SUD benefit (including the HEART Initiative ASAM level expansions) and the BHDD Medicaid provider manual.
